title: Sales By Representative for a past date shows the same totals
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an Expanded CSV of Sales By Representative exported before the release was installed, for a past date range with invoices, with Show Unassigned on.
  • Open the design pictures "sbr-00-b-sbr.png" (board 4.0), "sbr-01-b-sbr-filter.png" (board 4.1), "sbr-02-b-sbr-columns.png" (board 4.2) and "sbr-03-b-sbr-expanded.png" (board 4.3) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • With the release installed, open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, set to the same date range as that export, with Show Unassigned on and the Sales Type column turned on.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the export made before the release and compare each representative's summary row and the report totals with it.
  2. Click the chevron in the Date column header to expand every row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the same representatives.
  • Every summary row and every total is the same as before, to the cent.

Step 2:

  • Each past work-order invoice is one "Labor, Parts" row under the person it had before.
  • Part sales read "Part Sales".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-E2: “Every invoice created before the release has its one representative on both sides, so the report for any past date reads exactly as before, with that person's Labor and Parts rows shown as one "Labor, Parts" row (S5-R10). Invoices created before 2026-07-29 have no representative recorded; they stay Unassigned on both sides, and none is added.”
  • Release day: “Past invoices do not change. Each existing invoice's one name is copied to both sides, so the report for any past date reads exactly as before.”
  • Story 5 context note: “* Context note: the report already adds up labor and parts separately on every invoice. This story changes who is credited with each part, not how the money is counted.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
